title: A single critique finding, as one lens returns it

severity.description: S1 structural, S2 significant, S3 cosmetic

what.description: what is wrong, one plain sentence

why.description: why it is a problem, one plain sentence

rationale.description: why this exact point was flagged

evidence.description: the rule it rests on; name a law/pattern/case in parentheses when one backs it, else plain reasoning — never a fabricated source

example.description: a deliberately absurd scene that teaches the cause; required for S1/S2

fix.description: the corrected shape, one plain sentence

fix_rationale.description: why this fix removes the cause and beats the alternative

confidence.description: optional; add when the call is not obvious

falsifier.description: optional; what evidence would overturn the finding
